name: SWI Capital Holding Ltd.
summary: SWI Capital Holding Ltd. operates as an investment conglomerate. It has holdings across various verticals, including digital infrastructure, real estate, financial institutions, and alternatives. SWI Capital Holding Ltd. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Singapore. SWI Group is an investment platform specializing in real assets and alternative investment strategies to create value-driven opportunities at scale. Formed through the merger of Stoneweg and Icona Capital in 2025, the Geneva-based firm operates two primary divisions: SWI's Stoneweg Real Assets division focuses on real estate, infrastructure, logistics, hospitality, offices, data centers, and experiential ventures.
